messages:
julia_sales: FYI — large fintech prospect (NordBank) just asked for Dedicated capacity recommendations. They want embeddings + text-gen; ~50k requests/day, peak QPS ~300, P95 latency target 150ms, ability to burst 2x on demand. Sales asked for rough sizing + cost and rollout timeline. Anyone free to eyeball this?
ben_pm: Thanks Julia. quick clarifying q's: avg sequence length for gen vs embeddings? model family preference? commitment type (monthly reserved vs pure on-demand)? target go-live date?
julia_sales: Avg tokens: gen ~512, embeddings vectors 768 dims. Customer prefers a 'redwood-2-large' class model or equivalent open model. They're willing to do a 6–12 month monthly commit. They want go-live in ~8 weeks if feasible.
rachael_runtime: For that workload mix, rough back-of-envelope: if we aim for steady 300 qps with low latency using compiled kernels + int8 quant, plan on ~8x40GB GPUs steady state, plus 2–3 GPUs for burst headroom. Key levers: batching profiles, KV cache hit rate (especially for embeddings), and sequence length distribution. If they accept P95 ~200ms instead of 150ms we can drop ~20% of GPUs.
omkar_infra: On infra constraints: reserving dedicated pool in eu-west will require quota reservation; cloud spot capacity can be used for burst but only if customer approves non-guaranteed nodes. Network/VPC peering + egress budgeting needs to be documented. Provisioning time typically 2–3 weeks once contract is signed.
maria_cs: Heads-up — NordBank requires SOC2 and data residency in EU. They'll want VPC/private deployment and audit logs for requests. Also check customer IAM + KMS expectations.
ben_pm: Proposed customer-facing options to present: A) Conservative SLA: reserve 10 GPUs steady + 3 burst GPUs, SLA 99.9, rollout 8–9 weeks, higher price. B) Cost-optimized: 7 GPUs steady, aggressive KV caching + batching, target P95 200ms, rollout 6 weeks. C) Hybrid: 6 GPUs steady + autoscale to 12 (burst to ephemeral extra nodes) for short windows — needs ops approval and clear burst pricing. Feedback?
kevin_finance: We'll need the expected ARR or committed spend to model discounts. Also ask if customer wants committed usage with overage at a premium vs pure reserved contract. Pricing can vary 20–40% based on commit length.
rachael_runtime: Sample autoscale config for discussion (lab reference):
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 6
  max_replicas: 12
  target_gpu_util: 65
  burst_policy:
    enabled: true
    max_extra: 6
    cooldown_s: 600
```
Note: burst to ephemeral nodes means KV cache warming will be suboptimal initially — recommend a short warm period and sticky routing where possible.
ben_pm: Launch acceptance criteria I'm proposing: 1) perf validation on our perf lab with their representative workload and dataset, hitting P95 SLA; 2) KV cache hit >=50% for embeddings or documented mitigation; 3) e2e smoke tests + security checklist (VPC, KMS, audit logs); 4) runbook + rollback plan; 5) commercial terms signed. Owners: eng-runtime (perf + config), eng-infra (provisioning + network), product (rollout + acceptance).
julia_sales: I'll collect ARR + formal commitment and schedule a technical deep-dive with NordBank next Wed 10:00 CET. Can eng-runtime and infra join?
omkar_infra: Count us in. I'll prepare a quota checklist and network peering doc to share before the call. :thumbsup:
rachael_runtime: I'll prep perf test harness and a small sample dataset so we can run a sizing spike during the deep-dive.
deploy-bot: New provisioning ticket created: PROV-2026-1089 — assigned to eng-infra.
ben_pm: Thanks all — I'll put this on the product intake board, tag as high-priority for Q3 planning, and link the provisioning ticket + meeting invite. Follow-ups in-thread or feel free to DM for blockers.
